meta.units: metres in the RoadNet grid frame (+x east, +z south), x and z rounded to 0.1 m

phases.R2: ext.R2_EXTENT (grown 45 m); no separate R2a ring exists yet

sources.name: NYC DCP MapPLUTO (64uk-42ks) via NYC Open Data
NYC Building Footprints (5zhs-2jue) via NYC Open Data

meta.keys: lot.bbl is the key; buildings link to lots by bbl (lot.bins lists their BIN); lot.e indexes roadnet-core edges

lot.e: nearest frontage edge index in roadnet-core (at-grade, not highway/ramp); -1 if none within 400 m
lot.s: distance along edge e from its a-node to the foot point (m)
lot.sd: side of edge e: +1 lot is on the side where dir x offset is positive (grid frame), -1 the other side
lot.d: distance from lot centroid to edge e (m)
lot.blk: RoadNet block index containing the centroid, -1 none
lot.bins: BINs of footprints on this lot

fields.rings: footprint outer rings (flat [x0,z0,x1,z1,...] in 0.1 m integers) are keyed by BIN in cache/lots-real/footprint-rings-r1r2.json (git-ignored)
